1.2.1.1-n15-c1.reason: 'God himself is a cause for the punishment of sin, and satisfaction of his Justice' corresponds to 'O God, to whom vengeance belongeth'; Psalm 95 is a call to praise and does not fit.

1.2.1.1-p2-ic309.reason: 'Foolish men are plagued for their offence… wickedness' paraphrases 'Fools because of their transgression… are afflicted.'

1.2.1.1-p2-ic667.reason: 'He brought down their heart through heaviness' matches 'he brought down their heart with labour', which is the Prayer Book psalter wording of the same verse.

1.2.1.1-p3-ic438.reason: 'I am weakened and sore broken, I roar for the grief of mine heart' matches 'I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared… disquietness of my heart.'

1.2.1.1-p3-ic522.reason: 'O Lord rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chastise me in thy wrath' matches 'O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me.'

1.2.1.1-p3-ic621.reason: 'Make me to hear joy and gladness, that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice' quotes the verse word for word.
